title: Demo set on the rig's seesaw: each tray rocks about its middle (the ends tip), neighbours alternate, +/-5-15 deg (rocking.py)
rule: ranked by the worst robust score over every check run on the design (full runs; stiff-contact rerun; printer undersize 0.05 / 0.25 mm; stroke reversal 0.005 / 0.02 s for the firmware stroke); stress_tested says whether the stress checks were run. A flagged design that `verify` reran with stiffer contacts (dt 0.125 ms, timeconst 0.25 ms) with no failed or flagged run counts as clean. Otherwise: top 3 by robust full-run score (mean - 1 sd over 3 friction sets x 2 seeds, 16 s) among working sorters (robust >= 0.5, no failed run, meeting today's print constraints) with no penetration-flagged run; if fewer than 3 qualify, the rest are the best working flagged ones, marked flagged (see opt/LOG.md for how this rule came about)
caveat: sim ranking only; uncalibrated; openings simulated at nominal - 0.15 mm (ASSUMED undersize)
